atoms.a: There are 40 bikes split into 8 bike sheds. How many bikes are in each bike shed?
There are 10 boxes of doughnuts. Each box has 12 doughnuts inside. How many doughnuts are there?

instruction.text: Four packets of crisps cost £12. Complete the following calculations.

atoms.a: How much does 1 packet of crisps cost?
How much do 8 packets of crisps cost?
For every 8 monkeys in the zoo, there are 5 orangutans. If there were a total of 96 monkeys, how many orangutans would there be?
For every 4 fiction books in a library, there are 8 non-fiction books. If there were a total of 44 fiction books, how many non-fiction books would there be?

instruction.text: Lucas is organising his wardrobe. Help him by doing the following calculations.

atoms.a: Lucas has 28 pairs of socks and wants to share them between 4 containers. How many pairs of socks will go in each container?
Lucas wants to buy more containers to organise his clothes. Each container costs £3. How much will 6 containers cost?
Lucas needs to count the hangers in his wardrobe. For every 12 wooden hangers, he has 9 fabric hangers. If he had 60 wooden hangers, how many fabric hangers would he have?
